name: desire for stimulation
description: Physical or mental need for activity.

variations.name: comfort chemicals
variations.description: The brain can become quite fond of chemicals released during exciting activities like skydiving or sex.

variations.name: desire for novelty
variations.description: Wanting to experience something different than usual.

commentaries.quote: Often, 'boredom' is the same as a desire for stimulation, but sometimes you can be bored even when you're active at the 'wrong' kind of activity.
Being nudged by a thirst for action can be a good thing. But it can also cause conflicts.
The itch to try new things can wind up in disappointment, or it could lead to having more choices to optimize life experience.

conditions: After a period of quiet, a drive to become active.
